findings: Legendary gold Piss reveal is readable and uses the existing event style.
Yellow ribbons visibly land on the tabletop. Both rows show question marks and no effect icons in the affected view.
Restored view displays current values and effects after two affected-player turns.
A separate event instance preserves the hub emitter pose. Both caster origins and tabletop bounds were checked at runtime.
performance_note: Thirty-frame smoke samples of the full Main scene before and during the stream. Ambient effects and hidden card overlays differ; these are diagnostic samples, not an isolated VFX benchmark.
limitations: Steam and exported builds were not tested.
Some existing integration harnesses report ObjectDB timer warnings during shutdown; final accepted runs had no engine errors.
